name: cost-guard
description: Tracks what every task costs, estimates it up front, pauses and asks before a task, daily or longer budget is passed, keeps subagents on Sonnet or Haiku, and shows a themed band and dashboard. All figures are local estimates.

capSubagents.title: Keep subagents on Sonnet or Haiku
capSubagents.description: On: a subagent that would run on Opus or Fable runs on Sonnet instead. Off: subagents use whatever model they ask for.
